## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` and `npx tsc --noEmit` pass
- [ ] Rule or penalty changed → `RULES_VERSION` bumped
- [ ] Scanned text stays untrusted (escaped on the site, data in the finder); the scanner still never runs scanned code
- [ ] Wording says what a skill can do, never "malware"
